**10. Portfolio Direction?**

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive with broad participation but flat risk/Cycle ratios. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%)) and Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%)) showing relative strength while China (FXI CORRECTION (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%)) and crypto (IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%)) remain key divergences to monitor.
